datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2015 (January, April, July, October) for Burkina Faso. The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative or livelihood zones and stored in geographic formats (GeoJSON, KML) with scenario projections to represent medium-term food insecurity conditions.
